$comment: Spec 013 criterion 7: every command in package.json's contributes.commands, mapped to the web e2e test (its `it` title in test/web/suite/) that runs it, or to "desktop-only" with a reason (UNK-053). test/unit/webCoverage.test.ts checks this file.

chrJsonEditor.openInEditor.test: Open in CHR JSON Editor and Reopen as Text swap the active editor in place

chrJsonEditor.reopenAsText.test: Open in CHR JSON Editor and Reopen as Text swap the active editor in place

chrJsonEditor.selectFormat.test: Change Format re-parses in the host and the webview without changing the bytes

chrJsonEditor.repairJson.test: Repair JSON repairs in the text editor, asking before removing a comment

chrJsonEditor.smartFormat.test: runs "Smart Format" on smart-format/input.json in the text editor

chrJsonEditor.convertToJson.test: Convert to JSON, JSONC and JSON5 write a new file beside the document, asking before losses

chrJsonEditor.convertToJsonc.test: Convert to JSON, JSONC and JSON5 write a new file beside the document, asking before losses

chrJsonEditor.convertToJson5.test: Convert to JSON, JSONC and JSON5 write a new file beside the document, asking before losses

chrJsonEditor.convertToJsonl.test: Convert to JSON Lines writes one item per line, and JSON Lines converts back

chrJsonEditor.generateSchema.test: Generate JSON Schema writes data.schema.json beside data.json

chrJsonEditor.compareWith.test: Compare With… opens the compare panel of JSONC against JSON5

chrJsonEditor.compareSelected.test: Compare Selected opens the compare panel, and a copy is one undoable edit

chrJsonEditor.compareWithHead.desktop-only: UNK-053 ★: reads Git HEAD through VS Code's Git extension (vscode.git), which the web host does not have; github.dev's GitHub Repositories extension has no public API for committed content

chrJsonEditor.exportCsv.test: Export to CSV… saves and copies the CSV

chrJsonEditor.importCsv.test: Import CSV… replaces the document's data as one undoable edit

chrJsonEditor.convertCsvToJson.test: Convert CSV to JSON creates a JSON file opened in the CHR JSON Editor

chrJsonEditor.convertYamlToJson.test: Convert YAML, TOML and XML to JSON write a new JSON file beside the source

chrJsonEditor.convertTomlToJson.test: Convert YAML, TOML and XML to JSON write a new JSON file beside the source

chrJsonEditor.convertXmlToJson.test: Convert YAML, TOML and XML to JSON write a new JSON file beside the source

chrJsonEditor.importFile.test: Import YAML, TOML or XML… replaces the document's data in one undoable edit
